import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
n = 2000
k = rng.integers(0, 4, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (4, 12))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 12)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(12)])
df['group'] = [f'g{v}' for v in k]
df['label'] = [f'Base {i}' for i in range(n)]
# Second DataFrame (overlay) with the same feature columns.
m = 300
k2 = rng.integers(0, 4, m)
df2 = pd.DataFrame(centers[k2] + rng.normal(0, 1, (m, 12)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(12)])
df2['group'] = [f'g{v}' for v in k2]
df2['label'] = [f'Overlay {i}' for i in range(m)]

steps.eval: const ovId = a.layers.find(l => l.kind === 'point-overlay').id; a.updateLayer(ovId, { visible: false }); window.__ovId = ovId

steps.name: reorder: move overlay layer earlier in the stack
steps.eval: const sortedIds = [...a.layers].sort((a,b) => a.order - b.order).map(l => l.id); const ovIdx = sortedIds.indexOf(window.__ovId); if (ovIdx > 0) { a.reorderLayer(window.__ovId, ovIdx - 1); } window.__reorderDone = true
